parts.question: नौसेना कर्मियों की डाक पर इनमें से किस विवरण का उल्लेख करना आवश्यक है?

en.question: Which of the following particulars must be indicated on mail for Navy personnel?
en.a: Number, rank, other particulars, and name of the ship
en.b: Only home state and year of recruitment
en.c: Only Aadhaar number and current rank
en.d: Only name of Naval Headquarters and pincode
en.fact: The number, rank, other particulars of the addressee, and the name of the ship must be indicated on the mail.

clause_text_en:
28. Mails for Navy Personnel serving in INS Ships  –  Mail for Navy Personnel on board 
I.N.S. ships should be addressed c/o the Fleet Mail Office, Bombay.  The No., rank and other 
particulars of the addressee, as well as the name of the ship, should be indicated.
